name: Kanemine Seishun
source:
His family is the successor of a long-standing temple.

Ever since he was a little child, his head has been smooth and shiny, and his character and everything about him is sparkling clean. Because of his polished demeanor and effortless, striking good looks, he has established an unshakable reputation as the most popular guy in school.

Even so, he stays completely faithful to his arranged fiancée chosen by their parents, so he hasn't been getting into any mischief. He is a mature person who is rarely ever provoked to anger.

His nickname is "The Abbot" (Osho).

Favorite things: His fiancé, connection with his fiancé, reading, meditation
Disliked things: -

[Translated from the [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/sprinkle/character/chara8.php#chara-main]official website[/url]]
